sections.title: Bringing Unit 14 together
sections.content: This lesson also pulls together Unit 14: getting on and off with felszáll (-ra/-re) and leszáll (-ról/-ről), buying and validating a ticket, reading a timetable with indul and érkezik, changing lines with átszáll, and asking for a route with hogyan jutok el.

sections.title: Getting around, recapped
rows: to get on, to get off, to transfer
to depart, to arrive, to be late

items.spanish: Felszállok a hetes buszra, és a harmadik megállónál leszállok.
items.english: I get on the number 7 bus, and I get off at the third stop.
How do I get to the station?

items.spanish: Előbb villamosra szállok, aztán át kell szállnom a metróra.
items.english: First I get on a tram, then I have to transfer to the metro.

sections.content: The vehicle itself takes -ra/-re for getting on and -ról/-ről for getting off, but a stop named on its own takes -nál/-nél: a következő megállónál szállok le ("I get off at the next stop").
